name: Dragon, Caustic
body:
CAUSTIC DRAGON, VERY YOUNG
CR 4

This green dragon’s pointed scales flex menacingly and drip sputtering acid.

XP 1,200
LN Small dragon (acid)
Init +4; Senses dragon senses; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 15, flat-footed 15 (+4 Dex, +4 natural, +1 size)
hp 37 (5d12+5)
Fort +5, Ref +6, Will +4
Immune acid, paralysis, sleep
Weaknesses Vulnerability to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +6 (1d6), 2 claws +6 (1d4)
Ranged spine +10 (1d6 + 1d6 acid)
Special Attacks breath weapon (40-ft. line, DC 14, 4d4 acid, once per 1d4 rounds)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 9, Wis 11, Cha 8
Base Atk +5; CMB +4; CMD 17 (21 vs. trip)
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot
Skills Fly +11, Handle Animal +4, Knowledge (nature) +7, Stealth +11, Survival +8
Languages Draconic, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Acid Spine (Ex)

Acidic spines cover a caustic dragon’s body. A caustic dragon may launch a spine at an enemy as an attack, dealing 1d6 piercing damage and 1d6 acid damage on a hit. These spines have a range increment of 60 feet.

Dragon Senses (Ex)

Dragons have darkvision 120 ft. and blindsense 60 ft. They see four times as well as a human in dim light and twice as well in normal light.
